Title: Users may not be able to open email file attachments or see the "Open" option in the new Outlook desktop app

User impact: Users may not be able to open email file attachments or see the "Open" option in the new Outlook desktop app.

More info: Impacted users may be presented with an error that the file can't be opened and to restart Outlook to try again; however, the "Open" option is no longer available after encountering the error. Users can select "Save as" to download the file and then open the attachment to bypass the impact.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Exchange Online and checking for impact. We'll provide an update within 60 minutes.

Scope of impact: This issue affects new Outlook desktop users who have upgraded to Edge version 156.

Current status: We’ve determined that a recent update to Edge Version 156 unintentionally enabled an unnecessary configuration, resulting in impact. We’ve developed and deployed a targeted fix to disable this configuration, which may take up to 12 hours to propagate across our service infrastructure. We’ll use service telemetry to confirm the fix has been applied across the infrastructure. Once confirmed, users will need to close and reopen New Outlook for the change to take effect and resolve the issue.

Scope of impact: This issue affects new Outlook desktop users who have upgraded to Edge version 156. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A recent update to Edge Version 156 unintentionally enabled an unnecessary configuration change and is resulting in impact.
